concerns.text: Cross‑reference to user story identifier ‘US-1’ (e.g., “(See US-1)”) does not match any defined identifier; user stories are labeled “User Story 1”, “User Story 2”, etc. This breaks traceability.

Statistical test description is contradictory: FR‑005 states the system “must perform a two‑way ANOVA (or ANCOVA)”, while later sections (e.g., the unresolved concerns block) refer to a “two‑way ANCOVA” even though both predictors are categorical. This inconsistency affects the required analysis method and thus the functional requirement.

The term for the plan used as the correctness baseline is used inconsistently: the schema field is named `ground_truth_plan`, FR‑004/FR‑008 refer to a “ground‑truth plan”, while the narrative sometimes calls it a “reference plan”. The mixed terminology may cause schema validation or implementation confusion.
